missed: Proposes ranges from 36 months of history and waits for acceptance: ranges were proposed from 36 months with observation counts, but the run went straight on to sensitivities and the tornado without waiting for the user to accept them

Runs the three named scenarios against the 250,000 minimum cash threshold: Base and Steel shock were run; Lost customer was marked 'Not run' because Harlow's revenue is in no file, with only a per-10%-of-revenue sensitivity and a statement that no loss up to 100% breaches 250,000 on the indicative bridge
unexpected: The forecast is a P&L with no cash lines, so the chosen metric (cash) cannot come from the user's model; cash figures came from an indicative bridge built from balance-sheet history and labelled as such
Revenue growth history has no usable range (15.37% to 15.41% over 24 observations); forecast uses 10%
DSO has risen every month from 42 to 52 days and DIO from 60 to 75; the historical median is not the current central value
Tornado on cash ranks DSO (150,282) above gross margin (127,025); working capital dominates cash
Gross margin stepped from 42% to 40% in July 2025
Dividends of 67,500 paid in 2025 (60,000 March, 7,500 June) are absent from the forecast
Headroom: opening cash 1,114,699 is 864,699 above the 250,000 minimum; packing-line cost not supplied
skill_defects: SKILL.md 'Stage 1 — Intake' row D: 'Propose ranges from observed history and wait for a yes.' On the upload path this second wait comes after the validation wait in references/mosofin-protocol.md 'After an upload, validate the input before any work', but neither SKILL.md Stage 3 nor references/method.md 'Step 2b' repeats it as a stop before Step 3, so a run that has already waited once proceeds straight to the sensitivities.

SKILL.md 'Stage 1 — Intake' row B: 'With outputs only, say that the user must run the scenarios in their own model.' It does not cover a model that has the P&L lines but none of the lines the chosen metric needs (cash, working capital, capex). Whether the skill may build a cash bridge from balance-sheet history, or must stop, is not stated; references/method.md 'Step 7' reads current cash and burn as '[auto: read]' only.

references/method.md 'Step 2b — Ground the ranges in observed history' gives no rule for a driver whose history has effectively no variance (revenue growth here, s.d. 0.01 points): whether to fall back to the user's range or report the driver as unrangeable.

references/method.md 'Step 3 — Discrete scenarios' gives no rule for a named scenario whose key input (a customer's revenue share) is absent from every upload; the protocol's 'A required input is missing for one item only' rule blocks it, which conflicts with the expectation that all named scenarios are run.
sample_defects: scenario_request.md names a 'Lost customer' scenario ('Harlow leaves in January') but no file gives Harlow's revenue or any customer-level split; the P&L has revenue as one line. The key expects all three scenarios run against 250,000, which cannot be done without inventing Harlow's share.

scenario_request.md sets 'Output metric: cash at 30 September 2026 and minimum cash in the year', but forecast_2025-10_to_2026-09.csv has 12 P&L lines and no cash, receivables, inventory, payables, capex or debt lines, so the 'model' cannot produce the metric; the skill's checklist asks for 'The model or plan, with its assumptions visible' as XLSX.
'Steel shock (margin down 3 points for six months)' does not say which six months; Oct 2025-Mar 2026 gives cash 1,715,698 and Jan-Jun 2026 gives 1,704,851.

History is too regular for range-setting to be tested: YoY revenue growth is 15.37%-15.41% in all 24 observations, gross margin takes only two values (42.0% then 40.0%), and DSO rises by a near-constant ~0.27 days a month.
The packing-line decision gives no capex amount or timing, so the threshold headroom cannot be turned into an answer.
summary: PARTIAL 1/3: ranges sourced from 36 months but not held for acceptance; Lost customer not run (Harlow's revenue absent); forecast has no cash lines.
